description: Update the primary or joint insured's name, email, phone, or supported rating inputs for the eApp created through public MCP. Requires its private application_token and explicit user confirmation. Rating changes invalidate the selected quote and require fresh quotes before selection. SSNs, payment data, medical answers, agent/domain overrides, and signed/submitted application edits are not accepted. Give the user the private apply_link and explain that they must open it to continue in Quote & Apply, complete the remaining application steps, and sign where required. This MCP action does not complete or submit the application to a carrier or bind coverage.

application_token.description: Private application_token returned by create_life_eapp; an eApp ID, UUID, or completion URL is not accepted

gender.description: Carrier rating input, supplied by the user

health.description: User-supplied assumed health value. Get product-specific labels from get_life_quote_requirements. Never infer underwriting eligibility.

frequency.description: Uses per year: 2 less than monthly, 12 monthly, 52 weekly, 365 daily

user_confirmed.description: The user explicitly requested these application changes

name: update_life_eapp_insured
